name: Wrong Side
text: After your creatures are afflicted with a debuff, they have a 40% chance to remove the debuff and give it to a random enemy. This trait does not stack.

name: Xyrxzy's Control
text: After this creature attacks, the enemy attacks itself as well. The amount of damage is based on this creature's Attack. This trait does not stack.

name: Xyrxzy's Plan
text: At the start of battle, your creatures gain Mind Control. This spell causes enemies to attack 1 additional time when they're affected by this spell.

name: Xyrxzy's Subversion
text: After this creature manually casts a spell, it also casts 3 random enemies' spells as well. This trait does not stack.

name: Year of the Trollboar
text: After this creature provokes, it deals damage to a random enemy equal to 25% of its intelligence. This effect repeats once for every 5% health this creature is missing.

name: Yellow Tether
text: After this creature deals critical damage, its adjacent allies gain 30% attack and speed. This creature always has Savage.

name: You Monsters Are People
text: Enemies take 25% more damage from Blighted for each debuff they have. This trait does not stack.

name: You Ruined Christmas
text: Your Devil creatures share their innate traits with each other.

name: Yowl!
text: This creature can equip Spell Gems from any class. Your creatures have 10% more speed for each Sealed Spell Gem each of your creatures have. This trait does not stack.

name: Yuck
text: Enemies that are Disarmed cannot dodge or deal critical damage.

name: Zantai's Boon
text: At the start of battle, this creature gains Mega Magic. Your creatures' Mega Magic now grants your creatures 3 random buffs.

name: Zantai's Call
text: At the start of battle, this creature gains Mega Magic. Your creatures' Mega Magic now grants your creatures 3 random minions.

name: Zantai's Cunning
text: At the start of battle, this creature gains Mega Magic. Your creatures' Mega Magic ignores 50% of the enemies' Defense.

name: Zantai's Embrace
text: At the start of battle, this creature gains Mega Magic. Your creatures' Mega Magic now heals your creatures equal to 100% of the damage dealt.

name: Zantai's Envy
text: At the start of battle, this creature gains Mega Magic. Your creatures' Mega Magic now afflicts enemies with 3 random debuffs.

name: Zantai's Havoc
text: At the start of battle, this creature gains Mega Magic. Your creatures' Mega Magic now deals a devastating amount of damage.

name: Zantai's Inhibition
text: At the start of battle, this creature gains Mega Magic. Your creatures' Mega Magic now decreases enemies' stats equal to 25% of the damage dealt.

name: Zantai's Perfection
text: At the start of battle, this creature gains Mega Magic. Your creatures' Mega Magic has 3 extra Charges.

name: Zantai's Reign
text: At the start of battle, this creature gains Mega Magic. Your creatures' Mega Magic now increases your creatures' stats equal to 15% of the damage dealt.

name: Zantai's Stratagem
text: At the start of battle, this creature gains Mega Magic. The damage of your creatures' Mega Magic is now based on their highest stat.

name: Zealot of the Forest
text: At the start of this creature's turn, it increases your creatures' speed by 15% of this creature's speed.

name: Zenpang's Boast
text: Your creatures take 10% less damage for each time they've provoked in the current battle. This trait does not stack.

name: Zenpang's Exploit
text: Enemies take 100% more damage while provoking. This trait does not stack.

name: Zenpang's Yell
text: After your creatures provoke, they gain a random buff. This trait does not stack.

name: Zerda
text: Your creatures' first 3 permanent, healing Spell Gems each have a 20% chance to be cast automatically at the start of battle. This trait does not stack.

name: Zero to One
text: This creature can't cast spells manually. After this creature attacks, it casts one of its single-target spells on the target.
